newsitem.title: USA: Total World Telecomms sees 1997 EPS $0.90.
newsitem.headline: Total World Telecomms sees 1997 EPS $0.90.

text.p: Total World Telecommunications Inc, a full-service long distance carrier, said on Thursday it expected to earn $0.90 per share for the fiscal year ending September 30, 1997, $1.01 per share in 1998, $1.16 per share in 1999 and $1.46 per share in 2000.
"As we move towards the millenium, our corporate mandate is to not only meet our revenue projections but exceed them," said Chief Executive Officer Joseph Lents.
Total World said it saw $106.5 million in total revenues for the fiscal year ending September 30, 1997, $159.75 million in 1998, $233.2 million in 1999 and $363.8 million in 2000.
Operating net income was estimated at $6.3 million in 1997, $8.96 million in 1998, $11.54 million in 1999 and $15.1 million in 2000, Total World said.
Cost of sales was expected to be $81.4 million in 1997, $122.5 million in 1998, $178.9 million in 1999 and $278.3 million in 2000, the company said.
